scan_execution.reason: Pool RSS includes the pytest parent process family; importing all numerical/runtime modules first exhausts the unchanged per-job budgets. Run this file once in its own pytest process and ignore it only in bulk discovery.

run_client.reason: The supervised browser client uses the existing bounded pool; broad schema/runtime collection retains unrelated numerical modules in the parent. Run this file once in its own pytest process with unchanged RSS limits.
